NONE: › a turn made by a car in order to go back in the direction from which it has come
› mainly disapproving a complete change from one opinion or plan of action to an opposite one

example: It is illegal to do/make a U-turn on a motorway.
在高速路上掉頭是違規的。
The prime minister did/made a quick U-turn in response to all the adverse publicity.
面對所有不利宣傳，首相的態度來了個180度的大轉彎。
